script.problem: Moment 1 has 46 words. Keep it to 1 or 2 short sentences.

terra.problem: Neither passage says Jesus was in Chorazin when He pronounced these warnings. Both moments concern Chorazin, but their location is not established.
“Jesus repeated His warning” implies a separate occasion, which the passages do not establish.
Luke 10:13–16 does not identify the audience as the seventy-two; they are introduced in Luke 10:1.
Words such as “denounce,” “repent,” and “sackcloth” may need simpler wording or brief explanations for a fifth-grade reading level.
